meta.name: alfworld-device-operator
meta.description: Operates a device or appliance (like a desklamp, microwave, or fridge) to interact with another object. Use when the task requires using a tool on a target item (e.g., "look at laptop under the desklamp", "heat potato with microwave"). Locates both the device and target object, co-locates them, and executes the appropriate use action (toggle, heat, cool, or clean).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用设备操作物品完成交互任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在虚拟环境中用设备操作物品
copy.tagline_en: Operate devices to interact with objects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to use devices to interact with objects in a virtual environment

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 会按步骤操作设备与物体：先找到设备（如台灯），再找到目标物体（如笔记本电脑），把它们放到一起，然后用相应动作（开关、加热、冷却、清洁）完成任务。
howto.when: 当用户要求用某设备对某物体做操作（比如“用台灯照亮笔记本”、“用微波炉加热土豆”、“用冰箱冷却饮料”）时触发。

say.text: 帮我把笔记本电脑放在台灯下查看。
say.note: 会先找到台灯，再找到笔记本并放到台灯下。

say.text: 用微波炉加热这个土豆。
say.note: 会找到微波炉和土豆，然后加热。

say.text: 用冰箱冷却我手边的饮料。
say.note: 会找到冰箱和饮料进行冷却。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude will operate a device and target object: locate the device (e.g., desklamp), locate the target (e.g., laptop), bring them together, and perform the appropriate action (toggle, heat, cool, clean).
howto.when_en: Activates when the user asks to use a device on an object, e.g., "look at laptop under desklamp", "heat potato with microwave", "cool drink with fridge".

say_en.text: Put the laptop under the desklamp for viewing.
say_en.note: Locates both items and turns on the lamp.

say_en.text: Heat this potato with the microwave.
say_en.note: Finds microwave and potato, then heats.

say_en.text: Cool my drink with the fridge.
say_en.note: Finds fridge and drink, then cools.
